note: Alternative selection now shares the retired, dependency and parking eligibility predicate.
Anti-starvation rotation now excludes exact and nested deliverables owned by live workers.
Milestone guard queries pending recovery work scoped to the selected milestone.
Previous contract id is captured before the aliased mission record is updated.
Captured mission state persists the executor type used by the attempt.
Only a successfully settled diagnosis authorizes SAFE_REPAIR; completed failures no longer occupy the step.
EXTERNAL_BLOCK reopens when the repair contract authority hashes match current authority.
Receipt invalidations are saved before a later parked mission returns early.
A cached gate hold is invalidated when its causal quarantine disappears or changes.
The runtime no longer lowers frozen min_distinct_accept requirements.
Hardened review remains hardened and routes the declared reviewer with provenance checks.
A BLOCK on an exact SHA takes precedence over cached ACCEPT rows.
Prevalidation uses a replaced dispatch mission and preserves the canonical autopilot mission.
record_attempt preserves durable settlement idempotence metadata.
Stale recovery closure runs before the launch budget gate and persists completion.
Expired parking clears its stale fingerprint streak and allows a retry.
Stop policy reads canonical roadmap milestones when project state is empty.

Le prédicat d'éligibilité partagé applique la sémantique de dépendances du resolver canonique (retiré = satisfait, required_state ≠ COMPLETE non bloquant) ; voie alternative et rotation ne parquent plus un jalon à côté d'un jalon exécutable (milestone_selection.py:177 original). Second test : test_unblock_synth_001_rotation_shares_canonical_dependency_semantics.

Le gate_hold est identifié par la quarantaine causale exacte (milestone_id + entered_at) : tenu tant qu'elle persiste même sans milestone_id, invalidé quand elle disparaît, est remplacée ou devient la nôtre (settlement.py:155, runtime.py:2273 originaux). Second test : test_unblock_synth_002_hold_invalidated_when_quarantine_replaced.
